messages:
Maya (Product): Quick thread — putting the release notes draft here. Target internal announce ~15:00 UTC, deploy window 15:30-16:00 UTC. Pls review pin/rollback + comms copy.

Maya (Product): DRAFT NOTES:
- Feature: improve batching heuristics for short prompts (up to 20% cost reduction)
- Fix: kv-cache eviction bug causing rare OOMs on long-context sessions
- Ops: pinned model -> v2.3.1; fallback -> v2.2.9 (TBD)
- Rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30min with health gates

deploy-bot: Heads up — deploy window reserved 15:30-16:00 UTC. Automated canary rollout configured. Staging deploy scheduled 14:45 UTC.

Samir (Eng): I'll take the pining work if we agree v2.3.1. Suggest annotation in RN: "pinned for perf regression mitigation". No objections from model team?

Jen (Oncall): What are concrete rollback gates? Suggest: 
- error rate > 5% sustained over 5m OR
- p95 latency > 2s for 10m OR
- any increase in 5xx rate > 2x baseline.
If triggered, immediate rollback to pinned fallback and page SRE.

Alex (Release Lead): +1 to Jen's gates. Canary plan: start 5% for 15m, if pass expand to 25% for 10m, then 100%. Health checks: smoke, embeddings sanity, and cost spike monitor. Config snippet for rollout:
```yaml
rollout:
  stages:
    - pct: 5
      duration: 15m
    - pct: 25
      duration: 10m
    - pct: 100
      duration: 5m
  health_gates:
    - name: smoke
    - latency_p95: 2s
    - error_rate: 5%
```

ops-bot: Staging deploy completed at 14:46 UTC. Smoke tests: PASS. Quick metrics: p95 1.1s, error rate 0.2%.

Olivia (Comms): I'll draft the internal blurb. Need final bullet points and pin decision. Want one-sentence TL;DR for #internal-announce.

Maya (Product): Final decisions: pin = v2.3.1, fallback = v2.2.9; rollback gates = Jen's bullets; canary plan = Alex's config. Jen owns immediate rollback, Alex monitors dashboards, Samir will apply pining annotation and hold the model tag. Olivia will post internal announce.

Samir (Eng): On it — I'll annotate the release & tag v2.3.1 now, and add fallback tag.

Jen (Oncall): :thumbsup: I'll be on-call and will run rollback if any gate trips. Link to rollback playbook: <https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollback>.

Maya (Product): Olivia, proposed internal copy below — please edit as needed and post at 15:05 UTC so comms go out ahead of the 15:30 deploy:
"TL;DR: Deploying model serving improvements (v2.3.1) to reduce costs and fix kv-cache OOM. Canary rollout starting 15:30 UTC, pinned fallback v2.2.9, rollback gates in place. Oncall: Jen; Release lead: Alex; Eng: Samir."

Olivia (Comms): Nice. I'll post and include runbook link + brief FAQ. Posting at 15:05 UTC.

Maya (Product): Thanks all — if anything changes ping this thread.

Alex (Release Lead): Leaving monitoring hooks on and will post a short status update at each stage.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 15:31 UTC (5%).
note: This thread contains the root message and replies in chronological order.
